meta.title: KanjiQuizz — learn kanji in French | Camille Lupo
meta.description: Android app to learn kanji in French: finger tracing corrected stroke by stroke, spaced repetition, 2,211 kanji from JLPT N5 to N1.
meta.ogDescription: Finger tracing corrected stroke by stroke, and spaced repetition that decides what you review today. Release planned for 17 September 2026.

hero.title: KanjiQuizz
hero.lede: Learn kanji in French, with finger tracing corrected stroke by stroke and spaced repetition that decides what you review today.

device.aria: Reconstruction of the app home screen: 23 kanji due today and the six study modes.

problem.title: 2,211 kanji, one at a time
problem.body: French apps have no spaced repetition. The ones that do are not in French. KanjiQuizz fills the empty slot: French, an algorithm that schedules your reviews, and tracing corrected stroke by stroke.

french.title: Written in French
french.body: Readings, translations and interface. Not a machine translation of an English app.

stroke.title: Finger tracing, corrected
stroke.body: Stroke order and direction checked against KanjiVG data, right on the screen.

srs.title: Spaced repetition
srs.body: Every answer moves the next due date. The app chooses, you review.

kanji.title: Kanji quiz
kanji.body: Readings, meanings and composition, by JLPT level.

kana.title: Kana quiz
kana.body: Hiragana and katakana, to lay the groundwork.

vocab.title: Vocabulary
vocab.body: Words from JMdict, with their readings.

sentences.title: Sentences
sentences.body: Real sentences from the Tatoeba corpus, in context.

cards.title: Cards
cards.body: Free review, no timer and no score.

tracing.title: Tracing
tracing.body: Finger writing, stroke by stroke, corrected.

srs.title: You no longer decide what to review
srs.body1: Every correct answer pushes a kanji's due date further out, every mistake brings it closer. The home screen shows one thing only: what is due today. The rest waits its turn.
srs.bodyStrong: Progress is never behind a paywall.
srs.body2: Spaced repetition, statistics and sync stay available at every level, free ones included.
srs.chartAria: Chart of review intervals, from shortest to longest: 1, 3, 7, 21 then 60 days.

levels.title: From your first kanji to JLPT N1
levels.lede: The official breakdown of the Japanese-Language Proficiency Test, from the most accessible to the densest.
levels.aria: Breakdown of the 2,211 kanji by JLPT level: N5, 79 kanji, free; N4, 166; N3, 367; N2, 367; N1, 1,232.

pricing.title: One purchase, once
pricing.lede: No subscription, no ads, no consumables.

free.f4: Optional account to keep your progress

avail.title: Android first
avail.body1: The app is built with React Native. The Android version is the only one planned so far; an iOS version is neither announced nor dated.
avail.body2: The kanji quiz calls an API: a connection is required for that mode.

credits.note: Full attributions are also available inside the app.
